response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience as a Senior Software Developer and Staff Engineer, demonstrating strong technical leadership, architecture design, and team mentorship across diverse domains. His background includes open-source contributions, project management, and a focus on modern software systems. While his German proficiency is only basic (not meeting the C1 requirement), his English is fluent and his technical expertise aligns well with the role. His leadership in creating and maintaining open-source projects, as well as his involvement in mentoring and workshops, further supports his candidacy.
strengths: Extensive experience in software architecture and leadership, including roles as Staff Engineer and Senior Developer at multiple companies
Strong background in open-source technologies, with multiple open-source projects and contributions (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts)
Proven track record in team mentorship, technical workshops, and adopting modern development practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development)
concerns: German language proficiency is only at a basic level, falling short of the required C1
Limited explicit experience in UML modeling and requirements management, though his architectural work suggests capability
No direct mention of IT security, risk management, or compliance experience in the resume

key_factors.factor: Technical leadership and software architecture experience
